shots.detail_en: HOOK: black resolves into a 1993 CRT TV screen full of static; a young Xiong Tiancheng smiles on the interview seat
shots.sub: 熊（93带子）：「牛市是赌徒的天堂。我从来不猜行情——我只负责，送赌徒回家。」
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Old storeroom; the TV's blue glow on Changhong's frozen profile
shots.sub: 长虹（低）：「十年前的他……和电视里今天那个他，一个表情。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Imagery-only 1993 flashback, silhouettes: a suited silhouette standing at the rooftop edge of the old exchange; below, paper slips snow through the hall, crowd silhouettes surging at the windows
shots.sub: 93记者（带子旁白）：「联华指数一周腰斩，数万散户血本无归——」
shots.speaker: TAPE

shots.detail_en: Changhong pauses the tape; Hongli pushes the old ledger book in front of him
shots.sub: 红利：「这是我爹抄下来的93年成交底账。你先看这一页——」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Ledger close-up: June 1993, the same seat preaching doom on TV while absorbing massive sell orders, circled in red
shots.sub: 红利：「电视上喊空的人，账上在吃进。6月17号之前，他吃了整整九天。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Camera pushes to the ledger's last line: an account name's abbreviation circled hard in red — LU
shots.sub: 红利（声音发紧）：「再往下看。是谁的单子，把这口锅砸崩的最后一根钉子——是你爸的账户。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Changhong's finger stops on that line, knuckles white
shots.sub: 长虹：「我爸的账户……怎么会是砸盘的钉子？」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: 1993 imagery, faces never fully shown: FATHER's back at the counter filling an order slip, 12-year-old BOY watching from the rainy doorway — father and son in one frame
shots.sub: 父（闪回）：「长虹，在门口等爸——爸把这些票处理完，就回家吃饭。」
shots.speaker: FATHER

shots.detail_en: Changhong's head snaps up, eyes red but dry
shots.sub: 长虹：「他不是去处理票。他是被人骗到最后一秒，还以为自己在给全家止损。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Hongli flips out a yellowed clipping of the 93 interview headlined I TOLD YOU SO
shots.sub: 红利：「崩盘前九天，他上电视喊空；崩盘当天，他上电视说我早就说过。喊空的人，同时在做多恐慌。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: EXPLOSIVE BEAT, three mirrored cuts dissolving into one frame: 93 silhouette hands pulling in a net / ten years later Xiong Wei's screen of closing red dots / the 93 rooftop-edge silhouette and today's office back of Xiong Tiancheng — same composition
shots.sub: 旁白（长虹）：「一样的嘴，一样的账，一样的手。十年了，他连姿势都没换过。」
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.detail_en: Dissolve frame: today's interview BIGGEST BEAR MARKET IN TEN YEARS overlapping the 93 tape frame — the same smile, the same posture
Changhong slowly closes the ledger and stands, his back against the TV light
shots.sub: 长虹（低语）：「十年了，我一直把这根93年的大阴线，当成天灾。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: CORE LINE: he turns; in his eyes, for the first time in ten years, an open flame
shots.sub: 长虹：「账册告诉我，阴线是人画的。杀我父亲的不是熊市——是姓熊的。」
shots.speaker: CH
shots.fx: dead silence, then one low boom

shots.detail_en: The three stand in the storeroom as the blue light dies; only the echo of that line in the dark
shots.sub: 旁白：「这句他咽了十年的话，今天，有了账册、带子和日期。」
shots.speaker: NARRATOR

shots.detail_en: Mancang punches the filing cabinet, then crouches clutching his fist
shots.sub: 满仓：「我爹信了他十年……我爹信的是个电视里的骗子！我要他赔我爹十年——全赔！」
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Hongli holds Mancang down, eyes turning to Changhong
shots.sub: 红利：「不行。证据一出手，他会说是伪造的——账册在我爹手里十年，来历就说不清了。」
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Changhong gathers tape and ledger into his arms like carrying a stone tablet
shots.sub: 长虹：「不公开。留着。93年那根大阴线里藏着他的笔迹——笔迹，会自己长成证据。」
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: CLIFF: the storeroom's old telephone suddenly rings; Hongli answers — through the receiver, the soft click of prayer beads
shots.sub: 熊（听筒）：「带子看完了？——明早九点，联华旧馆天台。你父亲当年，也是这么找我的。」
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Slow close-up: Changhong's arms tightening around the tape
Black screen next-episode card with white bold text
shots.sub: 字幕：「他约他去的，正是父亲坠亡的天台。」
shots.card: 他约他去的，正是父亲坠亡的天台。
